facts.fact: INSEED states SNDS 2020-2024 was being implemented, with its remaining period to end-2025 to be covered by a revised action plan 2023-2025 put to national validation on 18-20 December 2023.
INSEED states a joint AFRISTAT, COMESA and PARIS21 mission carried out the mid-term evaluation of Togo's SNDS 2020-2024 on 5-9 December 2022.
